Tolerance block .X +/-0.20, .XX +/-0.10, .XXX +/-0.05. Contact rating 50mA 24V DC; storage temp -25..+75 C with the operating-temperature field left blank; manual soldering 350 C 3 s; operating force inward/exiting 5.0-10.0 N.

sources.evidence_extract: Hosted by SOFNG on www.sofng.com (product page title 'PJ-324M_耳機插座_硕方电子科技有限公司', product model PJ-324M, found via the 耳机插座 list page list_45_17.html). Technical parameter: contact rating 50mA, 24V DC; initial contact resistance 30 / 50 mOhm max (A better / B average product); insulation resistance 100 MOhm min 500V DC; withstand voltage 500V AC 1 minute / 350 V AC; durability 6,000 / 5,000 cycles no load, 5,000 / 4,000 rated load; storage temp -25~+75 C with '(Operating Temp:' left blank. Dimensions (mm): top view 1.6, 9.6, 8.6, 5.6; front view 11.5, 5.4, dia 3.6, 6, 3.2, 2.5, 4, 1.2, 5.2, 4.5; side view 14.2, 3.5, M6x0.5, 1.2, 13, 1.6. Tolerance .X +/-0.20, .XX +/-0.10, .XXX +/-0.05. 5/3POLE PLUG symbol: terminal 1 to the sleeve rectangle; terminal 2 to the upper (inverted-triangle) contact with terminal 3 drawn as the arrow touching it; terminal 5 to the lower (upright-triangle) contact with terminal 4 drawn as the arrow touching it; no TIP/RING/SLEEVE text. These values match the LCSC-hosted mirror page index 0 (src-a7-pj-324m-sofng-drawing); the mirror's page index 1 (CIRCUIT BOARD SIZE, Operating Force, Solder-ability, material) is not part of this image.

sources.authority_note: Acquired 2026-11-11 through the built-in browser of the Claude desktop app on the owner's computer (an ordinary page load, not the cloud VM that received 403/reset on 2026-11-08/11); SHA-256 computed in-page with WebCrypto over the exact response bytes. Bytes are not retained in the repository; re-download and compare the hash. Values were read visually from the image at native resolution. Manufacturer-hosted, so primary; it is a web image rather than a controlled PDF drawing and prints no revision.
